method: open -a "Mission Control"; window frames from CGWindowList during MC (WindowManager draws MC in 27.2.1: ExposeShieldWindow layer 19, "Spaces Bar" layer 14, "Window Highlight Overlay" on hover); expose-group-apps 0; solid Electric Blue and Tahoe wallpapers

2_overlapping.note: pushed apart vertically, scale 1.0, gap 13 pt

7_stacked.note: uniform scale 0.89; usable area about x 17..1692, y 108..1043; gaps 11-15 pt

rules: one uniform scale for all windows, as large as fits (max 1.0)
packing keeps the windows near their real positions (not a grid)
min gap between scaled frames about 11 pt
top limit about 108-111 (under the collapsed bar band 0..74), bottom about 1043 (Dock stays visible), sides about 17

backdrop.wallpaper: unchanged: MC = desktop (fit 0.995*x+3.5, same detail) on Tahoe light and on solid blue; no dim, no blur
backdrop.menu_bar: replaced by the Spaces bar band

spaces_bar.collapsed_band: y 0..74 (covers the menu bar zone); dark/solid blue: x0.8 darker (53,66,169 over 69,83,206); light/Tahoe: lighter (about 1.18x) and blurred (std 24 -> 6); 1 pt darker line at the bottom then a shadow 0.74 -> 0.94 over about 20 pt

plus.glyph: 20x20 pt at x 1674..1694, centre y 37, colour 229 grey

expanded_on_hover.thumbnail: 147x98 incl. a 3 pt accent ring with 1 pt gap (ring 86,151,245 over blue), radius about 6-8
expanded_on_hover.label: "Desktop" 13 pt white, centred under the thumbnail (y about 144..156)
expanded_on_hover.trigger: pointer at the top of the screen

spaces_bar.full_screen_app: its own tile next to Desktop, labelled with the app name ("TextEdit"); while a full-screen Space exists the bar opened already expanded
spaces_bar.glass: band is a blur+tint material (not glass rim), pill is a flat additive fill

hover.outline: accent ring 4.5 pt wide, 1-1.5 pt outside the window frame, colour (86,151,245) over blue; overlay window = window frame +7 left, +6 top, +6 right, +7 bottom
hover.title_chip: centred on the window (not below it), capsule 30 pt tall, text + 2*14.5 pt, SF 13 pt bold black text, fill (106,106,106) over dark window content; shown on hover only

timings: see MAC-ANSWERS R2 (enter 0.38 s, exit 0.33 s)
